name: Forbidden Love: Campus Crush
source:
You're the only daughter in your family, with three brothers. As you start new life in university, you feel homesick and miss the old days when you were with your family. It might be helpful to make new friends. As time goes by, you get to know more about the guys around you, as well as their deepest thoughts. They have different traits but all care about you. What you need to do is to follow your heart and choose someone you like to date with! A charismatic senior, a young thoughtful teacher, a rich and generous guy and a studious tech addict...Will you eventually find someone as your soul mate?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.icequeenmedia.android_forbiddenlove&hl=en]Google Store[/url]]
translation:
你是家裡唯一的女兒，還有三個哥哥。開始大學新生活後，你思念家人，懷念與家人共度的過去。結交新朋友或許會有所幫助。隨著時間推移，你逐漸瞭解身邊的男生，也發現他們內心深處的想法。他們性格各異，卻都關心你。你要做的就是聽從內心，選擇喜歡的人約會！魅力十足的學長、年輕體貼的老師、富有慷慨的男人，以及認真好學的科技宅……你最終能找到靈魂伴侶嗎？

[來源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.icequeenmedia.android_forbiddenlove&hl=en]Google Play商店[/url]]
